subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Which exact provider/session expression shapes and test fixture literals are approved as safe exceptions to the fail-closed credential scan?
rationale: The report is valid and bounded, but widening a secret scanner is a security-boundary choice whose permanent allowlist should be explicitly approved rather than inferred by automation.

options.title: Approve narrow explicit exceptions
options.body: Allow only the observed provider/session member-reference patterns and the three exact test fixtures, backed by safe and unsafe regression tests.

options.title: Require fixture wrappers
options.body: Keep the scanner unchanged and require callers to use already-approved placeholder forms or dedicated fixture helpers.

options.title: Redesign expression classification
options.body: Pause the focused fix and replace the current allowlists with a broader syntax-aware classifier, accepting substantially larger scope and review cost.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow explicit exceptions
recommendation.body: Allow only the observed provider/session member-reference patterns and the three exact test fixtures, backed by safe and unsafe regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their commits introduced the skill and most directly shaped the current secret-scanning and safe-reference boundary.
